title: Fish Tacos with Syrian Herbs
description: A flavorful and healthy fish taco recipe with a Syrian twist, featuring fresh herbs and flatbread.
instructions: Season the fish with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Place the fish on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the chopped herbs with lemon juice.
Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Crumble the flatbread into crumbs using a food processor.
To assemble the tacos, place a cooked fish fillet on a flatbread round.
Top with a spoonful of the herb-lemon mixture and a sprinkle of nutty flatbread crumbs.
